instructions.name: memo
instructions.title: Add memo
instructions.rationale: Validates UTF-8 text and logs it plus signer addresses; never writes accounts or moves value. The text is public and caller-chosen.
instructions.notes: NO DISCRIMINATOR: disc8 is a registry convention, not an on-chain value. The program never reads a tag; the ENTIRE instruction data is the UTF-8 memo (spl-memo processor does from_utf8(input); build_memo sets data = memo bytes; the official Codama IDLs list one instruction, addMemo, whose only argument is a utf8 string, with no discriminator). The first 8 data bytes are therefore arbitrary caller-chosen text, and a memo may be shorter than 8 bytes (the official docs example is 4 bytes). Integrators MUST NOT derive disc8 from the data prefix: for every instruction sent to a Memo program id, report the constant 0000000000000000 (rawPrefixHex is empty; equals `node scripts/disc.js u8 0`). Key policy on (programId, disc8) only: the all-zero value is also the canonical disc8 of tag-0 instructions in other programs, and a valid memo may itself begin with 8 NUL bytes, so the data prefix can never identify a memo. A Memo permission cannot be narrowed by disc8: it lets the agent publish any text on-chain, and if the owner or a relay PDA is passed as a signer the log shows that address as 'Signed by' for that text. Accounts: v1 ignores them; v3 and v4 require every account passed to be a signer (else MissingRequiredSignature) and never write them; no value moves. OTHER MEMO PROGRAM IDS (SCHEMA.md holds one id per cluster, so they are recorded only here; both verified executable on mainnet-beta and devnet on 2026-10-10 via getAccountInfo and `solana program show`; all three are no-discriminator, and the official JS client lists the three as every Memo address ever deployed): Memo1UhkJRfHyvLMcVucJwxXeuD728EqVDDwQDxFMNo is legacy Memo v1 (deprecated BPF Loader v1; source only validates UTF-8, no signer check, no log; mainnet-beta and devnet binaries differ). Memo4c2pN8afCj432Lb7RMVKi9PbQnnW7ewFFaV3oAH is Memo v4 'p-memo' (Pinocchio; same data format and signer rule; UTF-8 checked by the sol_log_ syscall) and is the id the official JS, JS-legacy and Rust clients emit for NEW memos (main eb5ca9ab0f4a77dc1e1f5d2af151a3ebcf7332d2), so integrators must handle it too; it is UPGRADEABLE on both clusters (authority GbX5VJUWBXgqDFKXZAmaneVHFuhauMVgvgGE7NPsJahD), so its behavior can change. This entry's id is 'Memo version 3' in spl-memo-interface, a legacy id in the official JS client (BPF Loader v2, not upgradeable; sha256 of `solana program dump` f520eaf096361abbb9639ea4dc3e5388a87b9330e121f476607b87c46ef67954 on both clusters). verification.disc8RecomputedFromNames is true only in the sense that the convention value was re-derived with disc.js; there are no Anchor names to hash.
